recipe.title: 15-second vertical matcha launch ad: 5 AI shots, beat-synced cuts, voice-over and bold captions
recipe.summary: A 1080x1920, 30 fps, 15.0 s vertical ad. Five shots in this order: whisking macro (00:00.00-00:02.40), pour into an iced glass (00:02.40-00:05.50), slow orbit of the glass on a sunlit table (00:05.50-00:09.10), person sipping by a window (00:09.10-00:12.20), and a packshot with logo text (00:12.20-00:15.00). All transitions are hard cuts; 4 of 4 cuts land on audio onsets of a 124 BPM lo-fi house track. A warm female voice-over (transcribed below) runs under white uppercase captions in the lower third.
recipe.likely_origin: AI video generator shots (smooth synthetic motion, no camera metadata, encoder Lavf) assembled in CapCut or FFmpeg with TTS voice-over and stock/AI music

steps.title: Create a look reference frame
steps.produces: look_ref.png - a still that fixes palette, light and props for every shot
steps.prompt: bright commercial product photo of an iced matcha latte in a tall clear glass on a pale oak table, soft morning sunlight from the right through sheer curtains, gentle shadows, pastel palette matcha green #8DB86B, cream #F4EEE1, oak #D8B88A, soft sage background #CFDCC4, minimal styling with a bamboo whisk and a ceramic bowl, clean airy mood, shallow depth of field --ar 9:16 --style raw --v 7
steps.settings: Use this image as the style/first-frame reference (image prompt) for shots 2-6 so colour and light stay consistent.
steps.evidence: Every sampled frame shares the same 4-colour palette (green #8DB86B, cream #F4EEE1, oak #D8B88A, sage #CFDCC4) and right-side key light.

steps.title: Shot 1 - whisking macro
steps.prompt: Extreme close-up macro, top-down 60-degree angle: a bamboo whisk briskly whisks bright green matcha in a cream ceramic bowl, fine foam forming, tiny droplets catching soft sunlight from the right, shallow depth of field, static locked-off camera, fast energetic subject motion, clean commercial food look, pastel green and cream palette, 9:16 vertical, 3 seconds.
steps.negative_prompt: camera shake, text, hands deformed, blurry foam, dark lighting
steps.settings: Duration 5 s (trim later), aspect 9:16, motion intensity high, camera movement: none.
steps.evidence: Scene 1 camera motion measured 'static camera, with subject motion'; frames 1-2 show the whisk and bowl from above.

steps.title: Shot 2 - milk pour into iced glass
steps.prompt: Side-on close-up at table height: oat milk is poured in a smooth stream into a tall clear glass filled with ice and bright green matcha, swirling clouds of cream and green, condensation on the glass, soft morning sunlight from the right, slow tilt down following the pour, pale oak table, sage background softly out of focus, premium beverage commercial, 9:16 vertical.
steps.negative_prompt: spilling, extra glasses, text, warped glass
steps.settings: Duration 5 s, camera movement: tilt down (slow), start frame = look_ref.png crop.
steps.evidence: Scene 2 measured 'tilt down (slow)'; mid-scene frame shows the milk swirl.

steps.title: Shot 3 - slow orbit of the finished drink
steps.prompt: Product hero shot: the finished iced matcha latte in a tall glass on a pale oak table next to a bamboo whisk, camera slowly orbits left around the glass at eye level while gently pushing in, sunlight from the right creates sparkling highlights on the ice and long soft shadows, sheer curtains glowing in the background, pastel sage and cream palette, crisp commercial look, 9:16 vertical, 4 seconds.
steps.settings: Duration 5 s, camera: orbit left + slight push-in.
steps.evidence: Scene 3 measured 'pan right (moderate), push-in / zoom in (slow)' - consistent with an orbit to the left around a centred subject.

steps.title: Shot 4 - person sipping by the window
steps.prompt: Medium close-up of a young woman in a cream knit sweater sitting by a sunny window, she lifts the iced matcha latte and takes a sip through a paper straw, then smiles softly, warm morning backlight creating a rim light on her hair, sheer curtains, shallow depth of field, gentle handheld feel, lifestyle commercial, pastel sage and cream palette, 9:16 vertical.
steps.negative_prompt: distorted face, extra fingers, text, dark room
steps.settings: Duration 5 s, camera: subtle handheld drift.
steps.evidence: Scene 4 measured 'handheld / shaky' (low amplitude); frames show a person drinking by a window.

steps.title: Shot 5 - packshot background
steps.produces: scene05.mp4 - clip trimmed to 2.80 s (logo text added in step 9)
steps.prompt: Centered packshot: a matte sage-green matcha tin and the iced matcha latte side by side on a pale oak table against a plain soft sage wall, empty space in the upper third for a logo, very slow push-in, soft even morning light from the right, minimal premium commercial look, 9:16 vertical.
steps.negative_prompt: text, letters, labels with words, clutter
steps.settings: Duration 5 s, camera: push-in (slow). Keep the tin unlabeled; the brand text is overlaid later.
steps.evidence: Scene 5 measured 'push-in / zoom in (slow)'; the logo text is perfectly sharp and static while the image zooms, so it was overlaid in the edit.

steps.title: Voice-over
steps.prompt: Slow down. Whisk up something good. Our ceremonial-grade matcha, ready in sixty seconds. Calm energy, all day long. Meet Morning Leaf - now in stores.
steps.settings: Voice: warm, friendly adult female, mid-low pitch (measured median about 190 Hz), relaxed pace about 150 words per minute, light smile in the voice, American English. Stability 45%, Similarity 75%, Style 20%.
steps.evidence: Whisper transcript (language en, 0.98) with speech from 00:00.30 to 00:12.90; speaking rate 148 wpm.

steps.title: Music bed
steps.prompt: [Instrumental] lo-fi house, 124 BPM, warm Rhodes chords, soft four-on-the-floor kick, shaker, airy pad, bright and calm morning mood, short intro, clean ending on beat 1
steps.settings: Style tags: lo-fi house, chill, morning, 124 bpm, instrumental. Trim to 15 s with a 0.5 s fade-out.
steps.evidence: Tempo estimate 123.8 BPM (confidence 0.71), steady kick onsets, spectral centroid 1.9 kHz, music under speech for the whole clip.

steps.title: Assemble the five shots with hard cuts
steps.command: ffmpeg -i scene01.mp4 -i scene02.mp4 -i scene03.mp4 -i scene04.mp4 -i scene05.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]trim=0:2.40,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,fps=30,setsar=1[v0];[1:v]trim=0:3.10,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,fps=30,setsar=1[v1];[2:v]trim=0:3.60,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,fps=30,setsar=1[v2];[3:v]trim=0:3.10,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,fps=30,setsar=1[v3];[4:v]trim=0:2.80,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,fps=30,setsar=1[v4];[v0][v1][v2][v3][v4]concat=n=5:v=1:a=0[v]" -map "[v]" -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p edit_silent.mp4
steps.settings: Cut points 2.40 s, 5.50 s, 9.10 s, 12.20 s each land on a kick of the 124 BPM track (one beat = 0.484 s).
steps.evidence: Scene detection found 4 hard cuts at 2.40/5.50/9.10/12.20 s (scores 0.62-0.88); 100% of cuts within 90 ms of an audio onset.

steps.title: Captions and packshot logo
steps.produces: edit_captioned.mp4 - burned-in captions and end-card text
steps.tool: FFmpeg (libass subtitles) - or CapCut Auto Captions with the 'Bold' preset
steps.settings:
Save this as captions.srt (UTF-8) next to the video:

00:00:01,600 --> 00:00:03,700

steps.evidence: White uppercase heavy sans-serif captions with a dark green outline in the lower third on frames 1-9; 'MORNING LEAF / NOW IN STORES' centred on the final frames.

steps.title: Mix voice-over and music, export final
steps.command: ffmpeg -i edit_captioned.mp4 -i voiceover.mp3 -i music.mp3 -filter_complex "[1:a]adelay=300|300,volume=1.0[vo];[2:a]atrim=0:15,afade=t=out:st=14.5:d=0.5,volume=0.35[m];[vo][m]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest:dropout_transition=0,loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11[a]" -map 0:v -map "[a]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -shortest -movflags +faststart matcha_launch_ad.mp4
steps.evidence: Source audio is AAC 48 kHz stereo at 192 kb/s; loudness -14.2 dBFS RMS with music about 10 dB under the voice.
